name: c-input-group-1
title: Basic input group
label: Basic
description: Basic input group

guidance.bestFor: The bare shell: one field inside the bordered wrapper with no addon yet, the base to add icons, text or controls to

whenNotToUse.when: A plain text field that will never carry an icon, text or action

name: c-input-group-2
title: Input group in disabled state
label: Disabled
description: Input group in disabled state

guidance.bestFor: A locked field that takes no focus or typing, with its Field wrapper flagged as disabled to match

name: c-input-group-3
title: Input group in invalid state
label: Invalid
description: Input group in invalid state

guidance.bestFor: The error look on its own, a red border on the whole wrapper with no message text printed below it
agentNotes: `aria-invalid` and `data-invalid` are hardcoded to true; set them from your validation result

whenNotToUse.when: An error that also needs its message shown under the control

name: c-input-group-4
title: Input group with prefix icon
label: Prefix Icon
description: Input group with prefix icon

guidance.bestFor: A single leading search icon ahead of the field, with nothing at the trailing end

whenNotToUse.when: A leading icon that also needs a visible label above the border

name: c-input-group-5
title: Input group with suffix icon
label: Suffix Icon
description: Input group with suffix icon

guidance.bestFor: An email field with a mail icon after the typed text and nothing before it

whenNotToUse.when: A search icon placed ahead of the typed text

name: c-input-group-6
title: Input group with both prefix and suffix icons
label: Prefix Suffix Icons
description: Input group with both prefix and suffix icons

guidance.bestFor: A listening state with a mic icon before the field and a pulsing red broadcast icon after it
agentNotes: Nothing records audio; the `animate-pulse` broadcast icon is fixed markup, so toggle it from your recording state

name: c-input-group-7
title: Input group with prefix text addon
label: Prefix Text
description: Input group with prefix text addon

guidance.bestFor: A fixed https scheme printed ahead of a domain field as muted prefix text

whenNotToUse.when: A scheme and a domain ending kept outside the border as joined cells

name: c-input-group-8
title: Input group with suffix text addon
label: Suffix Text
description: Input group with suffix text addon

guidance.bestFor: A username field followed by a fixed mail domain as trailing text
agentNotes: The `@gmail.com` suffix is display text and never part of the field value; join it to the username when you read it

name: c-input-group-9
title: Input group with both prefix and suffix text addons
label: Prefix Suffix Text
description: Input group with both prefix and suffix text addons

guidance.bestFor: A money amount with a dollar sign before and a USD code after a number field

whenNotToUse.when: Euro amounts whose sign and code sit behind thin rules on both sides

name: c-input-group-10
title: Input group with action button addon
label: Action Button
description: Input group with action button addon

guidance.bestFor: A text Search control at the trailing end of a query field, with no icon on either side
agentNotes: The Search `InputGroupButton` has no `onClick` and is not a submit button; give it a handler, or make it submit inside a form

whenNotToUse.when: A field and a separate outlined action joined side by side at a shared seam

name: c-input-group-11
title: Input group with icon button action
label: Icon Button
description: Input group with icon button action

guidance.bestFor: A read only share URL with one icon only copy control at the end
agentNotes: The copy `InputGroupButton` shows a `toast` from `onClick` without writing anything to the clipboard; add the copy call there
The copy `InputGroupButton` is icon only and has no accessible name; label it

whenNotToUse.when: A share link that also sets who may open it from a menu

name: c-input-group-12
title: Input group with dropdown menu selection
label: Dropdown Select
description: Input group with dropdown menu selection

guidance.bestFor: A calling code menu at the start of a phone field, its trigger showing the picked code such as +1
agentNotes: `country` only changes the trigger text and is never joined to the typed number; combine both when you read the value

whenNotToUse.when: A dialing number with country flags, a searchable country list and live formatting

name: c-input-group-13
title: Input group with keyboard shortcut (Kbd)
label: Keyboard Shortcut
description: Input group with keyboard shortcut (Kbd)

guidance.bestFor: A documentation search ending in a single Command K key hint
agentNotes: The `Kbd` hint is text only; nothing listens for Command K, so register the shortcut that focuses the field

whenNotToUse.when: Keyboard keys shown on their own, outside any text field

name: c-input-group-14
title: Input group with tooltip action
label: Tooltip Action
description: Input group with tooltip action

guidance.bestFor: A numeric limit with an info icon control whose tooltip explains the value on hover or focus
agentNotes: The info `InputGroupButton` in `TooltipTrigger` is icon only with no accessible name; label it, since the tooltip text is not its name

whenNotToUse.when: Help that opens on click and holds a title and a paragraph

name: c-input-group-15
title: Input group with loading spinner
label: Loading Spinner
description: Input group with loading spinner

guidance.bestFor: A busy state: a locked field keeping its value while a spinner turns at the trailing end
agentNotes: The `Spinner`, the input `disabled` and `data-disabled` on `Field` are hardcoded; drive all three from your pending check, such as a username lookup

whenNotToUse.when: A loading indicator shown alone, with no field around it

name: c-input-group-16
title: Input group with block-start addon
label: Block-Start Addon
description: Input group with block-start addon

guidance.bestFor: A header row inside the border above the field, holding a User Profile caption with an info icon pushed to its far end
agentNotes: An `InputGroupAddon` with `align` block-start shows first through CSS order only; the DOM keeps it after the field, so screen readers reach it second

whenNotToUse.when: A caption that sits above and outside the border and names the field

name: c-input-group-17
title: Textarea input group with dynamic character limit
label: Character Limit
description: Textarea input group with dynamic character limit

guidance.bestFor: A multi line description whose bottom row counts typed characters live against a 140 limit
agentNotes: A click on the counter row focuses nothing, since `InputGroupAddon` only looks for an input element to focus

whenNotToUse.when: A comment box with Cancel and Post actions under the text

name: c-input-group-18
title: AI Chat textarea with rich toolbar actions
label: AI Chat Toolbar
description: AI Chat textarea with rich toolbar actions

guidance.bestFor: A prompt box whose bottom toolbar holds add, voice and web search tools, a model menu and a send arrow
agentNotes: `model` only relabels the menu trigger, and the plus, mic, Search and send buttons have no handlers; wire each to your chat client
The plus, mic and send `InputGroupButton` elements are icon only with no accessible names; label each

whenNotToUse.when: A composer with mention, file count and tab count chips above the text

name: c-input-group-19
title: AI Chat interface with file and context attachments
label: AI Chat Attachments
description: AI Chat interface with file and context attachments

guidance.bestFor: A composer with a top row of an @ mention button and file and tab count chips over the text, and a model menu below
agentNotes: The 1 file and 1 Tab counts are fixed text inside outline `InputGroupButton` chips; render them from your attached items
`model` only changes the menu label, and the mention, image and send buttons have no handlers or accessible names

whenNotToUse.when: A prompt box with web search and voice tools in one bottom row
Attached files shown as chips with names, sizes and upload states

name: c-input-group-20
title: Input group demonstrating label usage
label: Label Usage
description: Input group demonstrating label usage

guidance.bestFor: A visible Search Components label above the border, tied to the field through a matching id

whenNotToUse.when: A compact search with only a leading icon and no visible label

name: c-input-group-21
title: Input group with multiple icons/buttons at the end
label: Multiple End Actions
description: Input group with multiple icons/buttons at the end

guidance.bestFor: A trailing pair of a muted star icon and an icon only copy control after a name field
agentNotes: The copy control calls `toast` alone, so nothing reaches the clipboard, and the star is a static icon with no toggle

whenNotToUse.when: A read only link whose single trailing control copies it

name: c-input-group-22
title: Input group with popover trigger addon
label: Popover Trigger
description: Input group with popover trigger addon

guidance.bestFor: A read only address led by a green shield that opens a Secure Connection popover on click
agentNotes: The shield `InputGroupButton` in `PopoverTrigger` is icon only and has no accessible name; label it

whenNotToUse.when: A hint that appears on hover over a small info icon

name: c-input-group-23
title: Input group with Sparkles icon and complex Kbd shortcut
label: Sparkles Shortcut
description: Input group with Sparkles icon and complex Kbd shortcut

guidance.bestFor: An AI generate field led by a green sparkles icon and ending in a Command plus Enter key chord
agentNotes: The `KbdGroup` chord is display only; nothing runs on Command Enter, so add the key handler yourself

whenNotToUse.when: A documentation search showing one Command K key hint

name: c-input-group-24
title: Input group with success indicator circle
label: Success Indicator
description: Input group with success indicator circle

guidance.bestFor: A filled username followed by a small green circle with a white check, marking the value as accepted
agentNotes: The green check is fixed markup beside a `defaultValue`; render it only once your availability check passes

whenNotToUse.when: A check still running, shown by a turning indicator

name: c-input-group-25
title: Input group with search results count
label: Results Count
description: Input group with search results count

guidance.bestFor: A log search with a leading search icon and a muted 12 results count at the trailing end
agentNotes: The 12 results count is static `InputGroupText`; compute it from your filtered rows

whenNotToUse.when: A search that also narrows matches by status through a checkbox popover

name: c-input-group-26
title: Textarea input group with action buttons
label: Textarea Actions
description: Textarea input group with action buttons

guidance.bestFor: A comment box with Cancel at the left and Post Comment at the right of its bottom row
agentNotes: Cancel and Post Comment have no handlers and the `InputGroupTextarea` is uncontrolled; read and clear the text yourself

whenNotToUse.when: A description box that counts characters against a limit
A multi line field with no actions inside its border

name: c-input-group-27
title: Input group wrapped in a button group with text prefixes/suffixes
label: Button Group
description: Input group wrapped in a button group with text prefixes/suffixes

guidance.bestFor: A domain field held between https and dot com cells that sit outside its border, all joined at shared seams

whenNotToUse.when: A scheme printed inside the field's own border

name: c-input-group-28
title: Input group with a menu button (three dots) at the end
label: Three Dot Menu
description: Input group with a menu button (three dots) at the end

guidance.bestFor: A file name field ending in a three dot menu of Rename, Duplicate and a red Delete
agentNotes: The 3 `DropdownMenuItem` entries have no handlers and the dots trigger has no accessible name; wire and label them

whenNotToUse.when: A search with a clear control, a status filter and a more actions menu

name: c-input-group-29
title: Pill-shaped input group with a category dropdown at the end
label: Pill Category
description: Pill-shaped input group with a category dropdown at the end

guidance.bestFor: A fully rounded product search ending in a category menu that starts unset and shows the picked one
agentNotes: `category` starts as the word Category and is never applied to a search; send it with the query

whenNotToUse.when: A company search scoped by region with a clear control

name: c-input-group-30
title: Input group with inline addons (no separating borders)
label: Inline Addons
description: Input group with inline addons (no separating borders)

guidance.bestFor: A euro amount whose sign and EUR code are set off from the field by thin vertical rules on both sides

whenNotToUse.when: A rule on one side only, before the currency code

name: c-input-group-31
title: Input group with inline start and block-end addon
label: Inline Block-End
description: Input group with inline start and block-end addon

guidance.bestFor: A muted euro sign hugging the amount with no rule, and a single thin rule setting the EUR code apart

whenNotToUse.when: A dollar amount with plain prefix and suffix text and no rules

name: c-input-group-32
title: Member row with avatar, email and role selection
label: Member Row
description: Member row with avatar, email and role selection

guidance.bestFor: A member row with a small avatar before the handle and an Admin, Member or Viewer role menu after it
agentNotes: Replace the `AvatarImage` src, which loads from github.com, and the `roles` list; the picked `role` lives in local state only

whenNotToUse.when: A profile photo on its own with no editable field beside it

name: c-input-group-33
title: Project save interface with status and action buttons
label: Project Save
description: Project save interface with status and action buttons

guidance.bestFor: A wide create panel stacking a name line over a description beside an icon tile, then a Save to menu, Cancel and Save
agentNotes: Keep `h-auto` on `InputGroup`: the textarea sits inside a nested div, so the wrapper does not grow to fit it on its own
Cancel and Save have no handlers, and `visibility` only relabels the trigger; send the name, description and choice from Save

whenNotToUse.when: A comment box with only Cancel and Post under the text

name: c-input-group-34
title: Pill-shaped AI prompt bar with voice and audio icons
label: Pill AI Prompt
description: Pill-shaped AI prompt bar with voice and audio icons

guidance.bestFor: A tall pill prompt bar: a plus opening an upward tools menu with a More submenu, and mic and voice buttons at the far end
agentNotes: The voice `InputGroupButton` hardcodes `bg-black` and `text-white`, so it ignores the theme tokens; use the default variant colors
None of the 9 `DropdownMenuItem` entries, the mic or the voice button has a handler, and the 3 icon only triggers have no accessible names

whenNotToUse.when: A multi line prompt with a model menu and send arrow in a bottom row

name: c-input-group-35
title: Password input with visibility toggle
label: Password Toggle
description: Password input with visibility toggle

guidance.bestFor: A password field with a lock icon in front and an eye control that reveals or hides the characters
agentNotes: The eye `InputGroupButton` has no accessible name or pressed state; label it Show or Hide password from `showPassword`

whenNotToUse.when: A password box with a strength meter or rule checklist under it

name: c-input-group-36
title: API request input with method selector and send action
label: API Request
description: API request input with method selector and send action

guidance.bestFor: An API endpoint bar led by a color coded GET, POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE menu and ending in Send
agentNotes: On the base twin each method row sets `method` from `onSelect`, which a Base UI menu never calls, so it stays GET; use `onClick`
Send has no handler; call your API with `method` and the endpoint path from it

name: c-input-group-37
title: Order search input with status filter
label: Order Search
description: Order search input with status filter

guidance.bestFor: An order search with a clear control that appears once typing starts and a Status popover of checkboxes with a count
agentNotes: `searchQuery` and `selectedStatuses` are kept in local state and filter nothing; apply both to your order query

whenNotToUse.when: A full bar of removable chips, each with its own field, operator and value

name: c-input-group-38
title: Company search input with region selector
label: Company Search
description: Company search input with region selector

guidance.bestFor: A company search scoped by a globe region menu of Global, United States, Europe and APAC, plus a clear control
agentNotes: Base twin rows call `setRegion` from `onSelect`, which Base UI menus skip on a click, so the region never changes; move it to `onClick`
`searchQuery` and `region` stay in local state; pass both to your company search

whenNotToUse.when: Status checkboxes in a popover that narrow the matches

name: c-input-group-39
title: Contact search input with filter and actions menu
label: Contact Search
description: Contact search input with filter and actions menu

guidance.bestFor: A contact search with per status totals in its filter popover and a more actions menu for bulk email, export and add
agentNotes: Replace `statusCounts`, whose 12, 7 and 5 are fixed numbers, with counts from your contacts
The Bulk email, Export CSV and Add contact `DropdownMenuItem` rows have no handlers, and `searchQuery` filters nothing

whenNotToUse.when: A search with only a status filter and no actions menu

name: c-input-group-40
title: Share link input with visibility selector and copy action
label: Share Link
description: Share link input with visibility selector and copy action

guidance.bestFor: An editable share link with a Private, Team or Public access menu and a copy control at the end
agentNotes: The Copy link `InputGroupButton` has no `onClick`, so nothing is copied; write the link to the clipboard there
On the base twin `setVisibility` runs from `onSelect`, which Base UI never fires on a click; call it from `onClick`

whenNotToUse.when: A read only link with only a copy control and no access setting
